# placeholder-example: documentation and template values that stand in for a real credential.
# the point of a placeholder is that it is not the secret, so flagging one teaches nothing.
export ACME_API_TOKEN=<YOUR_TOKEN_HERE>
Authorization: Bearer ${ACME_API_TOKEN}

client_secret = "$CLIENT_SECRET"
AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=<replace-me-before-running>
secret_key = "changeme-changeme-changeme"
database_password: "{{ vault.acme.widget.database_password }}"
    "authorization": "Bearer <token>"
